templates.why_chosen: High-confidence double-column pipeline in the phase-divided variant: a dashed horizontal rule splits the canvas into a Policy-Authoring band and an Implementing/Monitoring band, while three circled numbers trace the green process boxes across both.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a single dashed rule across the whole canvas to separate two operational phases instead of drawing two boxes, keep the numbered main-path boxes one colour against plain icon inputs, and label each phase in coloured text at the rule itself.
